copy.tagline: 进行蛋白质序列建模与结构预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正从事蛋白质相关的生物信息研究
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and analyze sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're doing protein-related bioinformatics research

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 esm Python SDK 处理蛋白质:用 ESM3 生成或补全序列、预测结构、按结构做反折叠设计,用 ESMC 算嵌入向量,并可通过 Forge/Biohub 远程推理。
howto.when: 当你要直接使用 esm Python SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型 ID,或 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端时触发。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 帮我补全这段带下划线的蛋白序列
用 ESMC 给这几条蛋白序列算嵌入向量
say.note: 返回可下游使用的嵌入张量

say.text: 把 target_structure.pdb 做反折叠,设计一条序列
say.note: 按该结构生成对应序列

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the esm Python SDK to work with proteins: ESM3 to generate or complete sequences, predict structure, or design sequences from structure; ESMC to compute embeddings; and Forge/Biohub clients for inference.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work directly with the esm Python SDK, ESM3/ESMC model IDs, or Forge/Biohub inference clients and ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Complete this masked protein sequence with esm3-open
Compute ESMC embeddings for these protein sequences
Inverse fold target_structure.pdb into a designed sequence
say_en.note: Generates a sequence for that structure
